headword: {正当防衛|せいとうぼうえい}

definitions.explanation: The legal right to use reasonable force to protect oneself or others from an imminent threat. In Japanese law, an act of self-defense that meets certain conditions is not punishable. Also used loosely in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正当防衛|せいとうぼうえい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}した→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧。
⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{正当防衛|せいとうぼうえい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: Self-defense was recognized in the trial.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{殴|なぐ}られた→殴る：02378_naguru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{正当防衛|せいとうぼうえい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{反撃|はんげき}→反撃：11944_hangeki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{過剰防衛|かじょうぼうえい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was hit first so I fought back in self-defense, but going too far would constitute excessive defense.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal term defined in Article 36 of the Japanese Penal Code. Also widely used in casual conversation when justifying a defensive action. The boundary between {正当防衛|せいとうぼうえい} and {過剰防衛|かじょうぼうえい} (excessive defense) is a frequent topic in legal discussions and crime dramas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正当防衛|せいとうぼうえい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}する→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧ (self-defense is established)
- {正当防衛|せいとうぼうえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}する→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧ (to claim self-defense)
- {正当防衛|せいとうぼうえい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ (self-defense is recognized)

RELATED WORDS:
- {過剰防衛|かじょうぼうえい}: excessive defense — when the response goes beyond what is necessary
- {緊急避難|きんきゅうひなん}: act of necessity — another legal justification for otherwise unlawful acts
